visual_action: A montage of clips and still images of Donald Trump. One clip shows him in a hard hat walking through a construction site. Another shows him sitting in a chair in a formal room. A still image shows him sitting in a polo shirt and a red cap, which is placed against a fiery background. Throughout the video, other images are superimposed over the main footage, including a photo of several men (including Robert F. Kennedy Jr.) eating on a plane, and another photo of Trump eating on a plane. The entire video has a strong red color cast and a floating red sparkle effect.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Donald Trump is the subject of every visual clip and image in the video.

cast.name: Robert F Kennedy Jr
cast.evidence: He is visible in a still photograph that is superimposed over the main video of Donald Trump. He is sitting at a table with other men on what appears to be a plane.

spoken_summary: The audio is a monologue where a man describes his past unhealthy state, saying, "I was so fat and nasty. I would eat anything. I was like 345 pounds, a quart of ice cream every hour."
audio_music: A male voice speaks over a low, continuous, and subtle ambient drone that creates a slightly ominous tone.
editing_pacing: The video is a montage with multiple layers of visuals. It uses superimposition to place still photos over moving video clips of Donald Trump. The editing also includes color grading (a heavy red tint) and particle effects (sparkles).
manipulation_or_satire: Still photographs are digitally superimposed over video clips of Donald Trump. For instance, a photo featuring Robert F. Kennedy Jr. eating on a plane is placed over Trump's torso as he walks. Another image of Trump is set against a digitally created background of fire.
central_claim: The video uses audio from boxer Mike Tyson describing his own past weight and eating habits to mock Donald Trump's physical appearance and imply he is unhealthy and gluttonous.
intended_effect: To ridicule Donald Trump and encourage viewers to see him in a negative and unflattering light.
